verdict.rationale: Foreloop's own docs describe an official CLI. It installs globally via npm, `foreloop init` sets up the task-executor skill, and every command supports stable `--json` output. It is built to manage projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks from a terminal, including from coding agents and cron. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, a full documented command reference

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: npm i -g foreloop   # installs globally, so the CLI works in any directory
Projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks from a terminal — and from anything that can run one, including coding agents and cron.
`--json` works on any command and has a stable shape. Additive changes only.
foreloop init installs the task-executor skill into the checkout, which is what teaches an agent working there how to claim and report on Foreloop tasks.
